rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Infostealer Credential Dump Velocity")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and not filter_legitimate | count(distinct target_credential) by host_id > 20")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:endpoint_detection
event_type="credential_access"
action="credential_read"
(process_name="\lsass.exe" OR process_name="\services.exe")
| stats dc(target_credential) as unique_target_credential by host_id
| where unique_target_credential > 20
rules.title: DL-0002: Infostealer Credential Dump Velocity (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Browser Credential Store Access
status: experimental
description: Detects unusual access to browser credential stores (Login Data, logins.json, key3.db/key4.db) by non-browser processes. Infostealers such as RedLine and Vidar systematically read these SQLite databas
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection:
        file_path|endswith:
            - "\\Login Data"
            - "\\Login Data-journal"
            - "\\logins.json"
            - "\\key4.db"
            - "\\key3.db"
            - "\\signons.sqlite"
        file_access_type|contains:
            - "read"
            - "open"
    filter_browser_processes:
        process_name|endswith:
            - "\\chrome.exe"
            - "\\firefox.exe"
            - "\\msedge.exe"
            - "\\brave.exe"
            - "\\opera.exe"
            - "\\vivaldi.exe"
    filter_av:
        process_name|contains:
            - "antivirus"
            - "defender"
            - "security"
    condition: selection and not filter_browser_processes and not filter_av
level: high
rules.title: DL-0004: Browser Credential Store Access (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Stealer C2 Beacon Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detects command-and-control callback patterns typical of Malware-as-a-Service (MaaS) stealers. RedLine, Lumma, and StealC use distinctive C2 communication patterns including HTTP POST requests with ba
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: web_proxy
detection:
    selection_method:
        http_method: "POST"
    selection_uri_pattern:
        url_path|contains:
            - "/gate.php"
            - "/index.php?id="
            - "/panel/gate"
            - "/api/check"
            - "/loader/"
    selection_payload:
        request_body_length|gte: 5000
        content_type|contains: "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
    selection_domain_age:
        domain_age_days|lte: 30
    condition: selection_method and (selection_uri_pattern or (selection_payload and selection_domain_age))
level: high
rules.title: DL-0005: Stealer C2 Beacon Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Infostealer Exfiltration Archive Creation
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of archive files containing credential-related file patterns consistent with infostealer packaging behavior. Stealers like RedLine and Vidar collect credentials, cookies, autofill dat
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection_archive_creation:
        event_type: "file_create"
        file_extension|contains:
            - ".zip"
            - ".rar"
            - ".7z"
    selection_archive_contents:
        archive_file_list|contains:
            - "passwords"
            - "Login Data"
            - "Cookies"
            - "autofill"
            - "wallet.dat"
            - "seed"
            - "credit_cards"
    selection_process_unsigned:
        process_signed: false
        process_path|contains:
            - "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp"
            - "\\Users\\Public"
            - "\\ProgramData"
    condition: selection_archive_creation and (selection_archive_contents or selection_process_unsigned)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0007: Infostealer Exfiltration Archive Creation (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Autofill Data Harvesting
status: experimental
description: Detects form autofill data extraction patterns consistent with infostealer behavior. Stealers like RedLine and Raccoon target browser autofill databases (Web Data, formhistory.sqlite) to harvest store
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection:
        file_path|endswith:
            - "\\Web Data"
            - "\\Web Data-journal"
            - "\\formhistory.sqlite"
            - "\\Form History"
        file_access_type: "read"
    filter_browsers:
        process_name|endswith:
            - "\\chrome.exe"
            - "\\firefox.exe"
            - "\\msedge.exe"
            - "\\brave.exe"
    filter_system:
        process_integrity_level: "System"
    condition: selection and not filter_browsers and not filter_system
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0010: Autofill Data Harvesting (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Crypto Wallet Seed Phrase Exfiltration
status: experimental
description: Detects wallet seed phrase and private key extraction attempts targeting cryptocurrency wallets. Infostealers such as RedLine, Vidar, and StealC include dedicated modules that search for wallet.dat fi
logsource:
    product: crypto
    service: endpoint_detection
detection:
    selection_wallet_files:
        file_path|contains:
            - "\\Ethereum\\keystore"
            - "\\Exodus\\exodus.wallet"
            - "\\Electrum\\wallets"
            - "\\Bitcoin\\wallet.dat"
            - "\\Atomic\\Local Storage"
            - "\\Coinomi\\wallets"
        file_access_type: "read"
    selection_metamask:
        file_path|contains:
            - "\\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn"
            - "\\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm"
        file_access_type: "read"
    selection_seed_files:
        file_name|contains:
            - "seed"
            - "mnemonic"
            - "recovery"
            - "backup"
        file_extension|contains:
            - ".txt"
            - ".json"
            - ".dat"
    filter_wallet_apps:
        process_name|contains:
            - "Exodus"
            - "Electrum"
            - "Atomic"
            - "Coinomi"
            - "MetaMask"
    condition: (selection_wallet_files or selection_metamask or selection_seed_files) and not filter_wallet_apps
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0011: Crypto Wallet Seed Phrase Exfiltration (Sigma)
